scope: Collaborator roster and evidence-based role scorecards across CFA projects
displayOrder: Current work and handoffs first; role resume and scorecards in a separate section.

roleDefinitions.label: Casting
roleDefinitions.check: Choose and refine character candidates against the scoped gold-standard references; keep lineage and creative lane explicit.

roleDefinitions.label: Writing
roleDefinitions.check: Translate the song and story intent into clear scene beats, dramatic progression and usable scene cards without inventing canon.

roleDefinitions.label: Direction
roleDefinitions.check: Specify intention, action, blocking, performance and eyelines; identify what the viewer should understand in each beat.

roleDefinitions.label: Cinematography
roleDefinitions.check: Specify framing, camera angle and movement, lens intent, lighting sources and continuity; make the proposed shot practical for the chosen tool.

roleDefinitions.label: Set design
roleDefinitions.check: Resolve scene geography, atmosphere and story-bearing background details before the shoot plan is verified.

roleDefinitions.label: Props
roleDefinitions.check: Choose and verify scene objects, counts, materials, hand contact and continuity, including money, cigars and breathing accessories.

roleDefinitions.label: Costume
roleDefinitions.check: Choose scene-specific wardrobe early, preserve approved construction and distinguish a wardrobe approval from actor identity approval.

roleDefinitions.label: VFX
roleDefinitions.check: Propose effects and finishing while preserving the accepted picture, performance and references; execution needs its own measured result.

roleDefinitions.label: Continuity
roleDefinitions.check: Check identity, dental map, visible tattoos, jewelry, hands, props, spatial relationships and temporal joins against the scoped brief.

metricDefinitions.label: Quality
metricDefinitions.check: Observed adherence and defects in the scoped deliverable.

metricDefinitions.label: Consistency
metricDefinitions.check: Preservation across comparable outputs or dependent video turns; one sample does not establish a rate.

metricDefinitions.label: Speed
metricDefinitions.check: Measured elapsed time, queue time, tool time and operator/courier time, with cold-start or service limits disclosed.

metricDefinitions.label: Rework
metricDefinitions.check: Actual repair iterations and operator effort; include rejected attempts, not just the final image.

metricDefinitions.label: Cost
metricDefinitions.check: Observed credits, currency and usage or unknown. Subscription price alone is not the cost of an attempt.

metricDefinitions.label: Tools and limits
metricDefinitions.check: Actual surface/model, observed tools, unsupported steps and reliance on a helper. Keep this separate from creative quality.

rankingPolicy.identityLikeness: Asset 1-5 stars mean likeness to the scoped gold standard only; they are not collaborator grades or preference stars.
rankingPolicy.scope: Compare the same role, task and input constraints. A casting grade does not imply writing, cinematography or video skill.
rankingPolicy.unknown: Unknown and untested remain null; unsupported direct execution is not an automatic F for planning quality.
rankingPolicy.humanAssessment: Human assessments, author claims and measured output grades remain labelled separately.
rankingPolicy.noUniversalWinner: No overall winner until the relevant task metrics, sample count, dependencies and limitations are recorded.
rankingPolicy.routing: Use the best relevant evidence for this task, availability and cost constraints; document team dependencies and scene-specific exceptions.
